assumptions.ordinary_weekdays: Weekdays outside listed exceptions are scheduled sessions and, within DTC coverage, normal settlement days. Unscheduled closures are not modelled.
assumptions.2027_settlement: Explicit exploratory projection from weekday, NYSE and Federal Reserve calendars. Strict date generation rejects it.
assumptions.exercise_decisions: Underlying core close on each session, a restricted Bermudan research convention, not the full listed American opportunity set.
assumptions.model_ex_event: Underlying core opening at 09:30 New York on the issuer ex-date. This is a numerical timestamp convention, not a legal entitlement timestamp.
assumptions.standard_expiry_regulatory_limit: 17:30 New York under FINRA Rule 2360(b)(23)(A)(iii); earlier firm cut-offs and modified-close provisions remain separate.
